messages:
Maya (Support): @Elena urgent: NovaLedger onboarding hit a provisioning failure in eu-central-1. Customer reports UI stuck on 'Awaiting capacity' and their trial kick-off is tomorrow. Logs show repeated 504s and a rate-limit on the provisioner API. Account id: novaledger-trial-09.

Elena (CS Lead): Thanks Maya. Can you confirm if it's a quota/exhaustion or an internal retry loop? Also ping SRE to see if there's a regional degradation.

Maya (Support): Quick paste: 
```
2026-03-20T16:40:01Z WARN provisioner request_id=ppf789 status=504 retries=4
2026-03-20T16:40:03Z ERR quota-check account=novaledger-trial-09 allowed=0 requested=1
```
Looks like quota returned 0. They requested a 2x burst.

Ravi (CS Ops): Recommended comms: 1) immediate acknowledgement + ETA, 2) temporary hosted fallback or assign burst from pool, 3) schedule a brief enablement call. I can draft the message.

Noah (SRE): Region eu-central-1 shows elevated error rate on provisioner, autoscaler is busy reclaiming nodes. We can patch a small window: increase per-account quota by 1 for this trial and kick the provisioner. Command: `infractl quota adjust --account novaledger-trial-09 --delta 1 --region eu-central-1`. That should let their job pass. We'll monitor for cascading effects.

Lena (Solutions Eng): I can take the 10:30 CET call and explain fallback options. Also will prepare a short ops play describing differences between Hosted vs Dedicated for their team.

deploy-bot: Quota adjustment request queued (req-445). Current status: pending approval.

Elena (CS Lead): Plan: approve temporary +1 quota, notify customer we're granting a small burst and monitoring, offer call at 10:30 CET, and promise a detailed follow-up and credits if SLA impacted. Ravi please send the first message and include guidance to avoid re-triggering heavy provisioning until we confirm stability. Noah please approve the delta if safe.

Noah (SRE): Approved delta and applied. Provision job retried and transitioned to active. Monitoring shows success.

Ravi (CS Ops): Draft customer note below, please edit: 

"Hi NovaLedger team  
We're sorry for the disruption. We've identified a regional provisioning quota limit in eu-central-1 affecting some trials, and we've temporarily granted your account a small burst so your onboarding can continue. The provisioning job is now active and we are monitoring. We expect full stability within 10-20 minutes. Lena is available for a quick call at 10:30 CET to walk through the workaround and what to expect. We'll follow up with a timeline and any remedial credits if your SLA was impacted.

Best,
Ravi on behalf of Redwood"

Elena (CS Lead): Sent to customer and scheduled the call. Ask them to pause any parallel provisioning attempts. Good job.

Maya (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks — confirmed progress, appreciate quick response." Closing loop. Will add postmortem link when Noah creates it.

Noah (SRE): Creating RCA ticket now; will include recommended autoscaler tuning and a safety buffer for trials.

Elena (CS Lead): Assign postmortem to Noah for infra, Lena for customer-facing summary, Ravi for timeline + credits recommendation. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
